import sys

MOD = 1000000007
memo = None
N = 0

def solve(n):
    global N, memo
    N = 2 * n
    memo = [[[-1, -1] for _ in range(N + 1)] for _ in range(N + 1)]
    memo[0][0][0] = 0
    memo[0][0][1] = 0
    return f(N, 0, 0)

def f(i, j, k):
    if i == 0:
        return 0
    if memo[i][j][k] != -1:
        return memo[i][j][k]
    if k == 1:
        res = 0
        if i - j >= 2:
            res = add(res, f(i - 1, j + 1, 0))
        if j > 0:
            res = add(res, f(i - 1, j - 1, 0))
    else:
        res = max(get(i, j, False, False),
                  max(get(i, j, False, True), get(i, j, True, False)))
    memo[i][j][k] = res
    return res

def get(i, j, selectStart, selectEnd):
    ret = 0
    if i - j >= 2:
        if selectStart:
            ret = add(ret, f(i - 1, j + 1, 1))
            ret = add(ret, 1)
        else:
            ret = add(ret, f(i - 1, j + 1, 0))
    if j > 0:
        if selectEnd:
            ret = add(ret, f(i - 1, j - 1, 1))
            ret = add(ret, 1)
        else:
            ret = add(ret, f(i - 1, j - 1, 0))
    return ret

def add(a, b):
    res = a + b
    if res >= MOD:
        res -= MOD
    return res

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    print(solve(n))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
